text:
Priya Nair: Hey infra team — onboarding a new customer org, need help getting accel + ENI ceilings in two regions (eu-west-4, ap-south-1). Account IDs: 123456789012 (prod), 210987654321 (staging). Can we kick off quota requests to AWS and get a temporary fallback while they wait?
Devon Chen: Thanks — can you paste exact instance types and target counts? also, are these for Dedicated pools or just initial test fleets?
Priya Nair: Quick details: prod will need Reserved/Dedicated capacity for 2x p5.48xlarge and 4x g5.48xlarge steady; staging needs 1x p4d.24xlarge and 2x g5.12xlarge. Networking: each instance needs up to 50 ENIs due to multi-NIC setup (we use ENI-rich placement). Expect initial subnet /26 per AZ may be tight.
Marcus Li: Copy — big ask but reasonable. For quota requests we should ask for:
```
Service Quotas request (per region):
- p5 (p5.48xlarge): 4 running instances
- p4d (p4d.24xlarge): 2 running instances
- g5 (g5.48xlarge/g5.12xlarge): 8 running instances (split)
- Elastic Network Interfaces: 200 per AZ (account-level)
- ENI IPs / subnet size: need /24 preferred, fallback /26 with burst plan
```
Marcus Li: Also request EC2 instance vCPU and vGPU soft-limits bumped, and increase for Service-Linked Role quotas if present.
Priya Nair: Business justification to include in support case: enterprise customer with SLA requirement, will run production inference workloads (steady 50–200 inference qps per p5), committed revenue + reserved capacity contract.
Devon Chen: I'll open the AWS Support case and ping the TAM. Drafting message to AWS — want me to include cost/commitment numbers? that usually helps escalate.
Priya Nair: Yes include committed monthly spend estimate (~$120k/month across regions) and contract start date 2026-04-15. Also ask for temporary burst capacity for two weeks to avoid rollout stall.
infra-bot: Support case created: case #12033456 — quota requests filed for eu-west-4 and ap-south-1. Awaiting TAM follow-up.
Marcus Li: Thanks infra-bot. I'll prepare a Terraform-friendly fallback: spin up in eu-west-3 if quotas lag, with automatic routing via smart-routing rules. Also, check subnet sizes and request ENI quotas per VPC/AZ not just account.
Devon Chen: AWS TAM replied: requested a meeting, wants network diagram + AZ breakdown + CIDR ranges. Can someone attach VPC/ subnet layout and current ENI usage snapshot?
Priya Nair: Uploading diagrams and current usage in the thread now. Short-term ask: please escalate ENI and instance count approvals, and if TAM offers time-limited Dedicated capacity provide contact for procurement.
Marcus Li: Action items: Devon to send case notes + cost justification to TAM (today), Priya to share VPC diagrams and exact CIDRs, Marcus to prepare fallback eu-west-3 config and small automation to switch routes. I'll monitor quotas and update channel when approvals land. :thumbsup:
Devon Chen: On it. ping me if TAM asks for an SRA or account owner contact.
Priya Nair: Thanks all — would love a rough ETA on approvals if anyone hears back (multiday ok, just need to plan canary).
AWS TAM: Preliminary: we can provision interim capacity in eu-west-3 while we validate account limits for eu-west-4. For ap-south-1 we need VPC CIDRs and justification for 50 ENIs per instance. Meeting scheduled 2026-01-22 13:00 UTC.
Marcus Li: Great — keep this thread updated. If TAM pushes back on ENIs, fallback is to change NIC strategy (reduce ENIs via internal proxy) but that impacts perf. We'll aim to avoid it.
Priya Nair: Noted. Closing the loop — will post meeting notes and next steps after the call. Thanks everyone.
